# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God's Discipline of the Righteous; Israel's Messianic Hope

---

**9:1** When Israel was led away captive into a foreign land,
when they were scattered from Jerusalem to east and west,

**9:2** they sang in humility to God, to the praise of his name;
they made known in the synagogues his mighty acts.

**9:3** Our God is great and glorious,
dwelling in the highest [heaven];

**9:4** who has ordered the lights of heaven for the times of the seasons,
from year to year;

**9:5** and they did not depart from the order he set for them
in all their course.

**9:6** In the fear of God is their way every day,
from the day when God created them and forever.

**9:7** And they have not strayed since the day he created them;
they have not wandered from the ancient way,
except when God commanded them a new [path].

**9:8** The ways of men are known before him at all times;
he knows the secrets of the heart before they come into being.

**9:9** Therefore his discipline is upon us as a father [disciplines] a firstborn son,
to turn away the obedient soul from ignorant sin.

**9:10** May God cleanse Israel for the day of mercy and blessing,
for the day of election when he brings back his anointed.

**9:11** Blessed are those who will be in those days,
to see the good things of the LORD which he shall do for the generation to come;
under the rod of the LORD's anointed.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Greek (Codex Vindobonensis). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
